title: Daxor Accelerates Commercial Expansion of Next-Gen Blood Volume Diagnostic Platform at MedAxiom CV Transforum Fall ’26
summary: OAK RIDGE, Tenn. – October 15, 2026 – Daxor Corporation (Nasdaq: DXR), the global leader in blood volume measurement technology, today announced its
body_markdown:
### *FDA-cleared BVA™ technology delivers lab-accurate precision to optimize cardiovascular service lines, reduce 30-day readmissions, and lower cost of care.*


### **Key Highlights:**


- **Commercial Acceleration:** Daxor showcasing its next-generation Blood Volume Analyzer (BVA) platform to executive service line leaders and cardiovascular administrators


- **Operational & Economic Impact:** Demonstrating how direct volume measurement eliminates subjective estimation, shortens length of stay, and targets key value-based metrics in cardiac care


- **Executive Presence:** Commercial leadership hosting platform demonstrations at the MedAxiom CV Transforum Fall ’26 in Denver, CO (October 22–24, 2026)


**OAK RIDGE, Tenn. – October 15, 2026** –


[Daxor Corporation](http://www.daxor.com/) (Nasdaq: DXR), the global leader in blood volume measurement technology, today announced its participation at the MedAxiom Cardiovascular (CV) Transforum Fall ’26 Conference, held at the Gaylord Rockies Resort & Convention Center in Denver, Colorado, from October 22–24, 2026. The CV Transforum is the nation’s premier conference dedicated to cardiovascular organizational performance and health system transformation.


Daxor will highlight its FDA 510(k)-cleared, next-generation, lab-based BVA platform. Operating


**3x faster** than its predecessor, requiring


**50% less sample volume** , and delivering


**>95% measurement accuracy** , the platform brings lab-standard precision directly into rapid inpatient and outpatient clinical workflows.


*“MedAxiom’s CV Transforum is the ideal environment to demonstrate how direct blood volume measurement transforms both clinical outcomes and health system economics,”* said


**Michael Feldschuh** , President and Chief Executive Officer of Daxor.


*“Cardiovascular care remains one of the largest cost drivers for health systems nationwide. By replacing subjective surrogate measures with direct, precise data, our next-generation BVA system empowers cardiovascular programs to reduce 30-day readmissions, optimize length of stay, and achieve meaningful efficiencies under value-based care models.”*


### **Driving Clinical & Financial Performance in Cardiovascular Care**


Traditional reliance on physical exams, weight changes, and blood chemistry surrogates frequently misidentifies fluid status, leading to unnecessary readmissions and prolonged hospital stays. Daxor’s BVA technology directly quantifies total blood volume, plasma volume, and red blood cell volume against individualized patient norms, allowing clinicians to optimize volume.


### **Connect with Daxor at CV Transforum Fall ’26**


Cardiovascular service line directors, CFOs, and clinical leaders are invited to meet with Daxor’s commercial leadership team during the exposition to review institutional ROI models, clinical workflow integration, and technology demonstrations.


To schedule a direct meeting with Daxor leadership at the conference or to learn more,


[contact us here](https://daxor.com/contact-us/) .

This empowers clinicians to make individualized treatment decisions that significantly improve patient outcomes and deliver substantial efficiencies in value-based healthcare. Daxor is ISO certified and operates a U.S.-based, 20,000-square-foot state-of-the-art manufacturing facility, positioning the company for accelerated market expansion.
